filter.title: Soft blur
filter.desc: Gaussian blur whose edges fade out, for elements, text, icons and shapes.

filter.data-note: Makes transparent areas opaque: not for text or cut-out shapes. Pair it with the `--bg` class.
filter.title: Solid-edge blur
filter.desc: Gaussian blur with duplicated edges and forced opacity, so rectangular images and backgrounds keep a crisp border.
